Vidérunt eam * fíliæ Sion, et beatíssima: 她们见了她 * 熙雍的女儿们，齐称她为至福者。。
_notes: This is a Marian antiphon combining Song of Songs 6:9 (熙雍女郎见了她) and Proverbs 31:28 (称她有福) vocabulary. 思高 SoS 6:9: '少女见了她，都称她有福'. The Latin 'pr’dicavérunt' = prædicavérunt (Unicode apostrophe substituting æ in source). The trailing '..' is the chant double-period termination mark, preserved verbatim. 'beatíssimam' (superlative of beata) rendered 至福者 to reflect the superlative force. 'fíliæ Sion' = 熙雍的女儿们 per glossary §7 (Sion = 熙雍).
